title: Fractions and percentages
summary: Equivalent and mixed fractions, ordering, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing fractions, percentages and ratios.

cards.title: Introduction to fractions
cards.rule: The bottom says how many equal parts. The top says how many you have.
lines: Improper: \(\tfrac54\) is more than a whole

cards.title: Equivalent fractions
cards.rule: Multiply or divide the top and bottom by the same number.

cards.title: Mixed and improper
cards.rule: Multiply the whole by the bottom, then add the top.

cards.title: Ordering fractions
cards.rule: Rewrite with a common denominator, then compare the tops.

cards.title: Adding fractions
cards.rule: Common denominator first, then add the tops only.

cards.title: Subtracting fractions
cards.rule: Common denominator first, then subtract the tops.

cards.title: Multiplying fractions
cards.rule: Top times top, bottom times bottom. No common denominator needed.

cards.title: Dividing fractions
cards.rule: Flip the second fraction, then multiply.

cards.title: Percentage of a number
cards.rule: Find 10% first, or multiply by the percentage as a fraction.

cards.title: Introduction to ratios
cards.rule: A ratio compares amounts. Order matters.
lines: 3 red and 5 blue: red to blue is **3 : 5**

cards.title: Problems with ratios
cards.rule: Add the parts, find one part, then multiply.
